name: tr-tax-tax-offices
title: Tax offices of Türkiye
description: Tax offices (vergi dairesi müdürlüğü) and the treasury office acting as one (Eskişehir Defterdarlığı) of Türkiye with their accounting unit codes, plus the branch offices (şube) that depend on them.

sources.title: Defterdarlık ve Vergi Daireleri Listesi (Gelir İdaresi Başkanlığı), dated 2026-06-18

fields.name: code
fields.description: Five-digit accounting unit code (MUH.BİR. KODU) of the tax office, as a string. It is not derived from the province code.

fields.name: province_code
fields.description: Two-digit province code. References code in tr-address-provinces.

fields.name: district
fields.description: District (ilçe) name as listed by the source. Merkez means the central district of the province.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Official name of the office in Turkish.

fields.name: type
fields.description: tax_office for a Vergi Dairesi Müdürlüğü; treasury_office for the Defterdarlık that also acts as tax office (marked (*) in the source).

fields.name: district_center_by_law_6360
fields.description: true when the source marks the district with (**), meaning it is treated as central district under Law No. 6360.

fields.name: province_code
fields.description: Two-digit province code. References code in tr-address-provinces.

fields.name: district
fields.description: District (ilçe) name as listed by the source.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Name of the branch (Şubesi) in Turkish. The source gives no code and does not name the parent office.

fields.name: district_center_by_law_6360
fields.description: true when the source marks the district with (**), as in tax-offices.
